study: Frozen-3EED recurrent role-support and continuous-box joint decoder
hypothesis: Learned subject/reference interaction and relative geometry feedback improve cross-platform subject localization over the same source supervision and evidence without interaction/feedback.

source_protocol.natural: All usable rows from the pinned single-platform source TRAIN manifests. Subject boxes from existing labels. Natural references remain unsupervised.
source_protocol.holdout: Use whole recordings as a source-only diagnostic split. Hold the smallest recording on Drone and Quad to retain the available training mass, and a hash-fixed approximately 10 percent of recordings on Waymo. Source diagnostics do not select checkpoints.
source_protocol.synthetic: At most 768 train and 192 diagnostic expressions per platform, recording round-robin and one per camera frame. In the visible annotated inventory, identify a unique-class or geometrically separated leftmost/rightmost reference, then a uniquely closest same-class subject on the described side by horizontal image coordinate. Require another visible subject-class distractor, separated chosen intervals, and a winner margin. These relations are verified relative to the source inventory.
source_protocol.frozen: Three existing single-source 3EED epoch100 checkpoints and the corresponding R76/R91 RGB stems. No external grounding expert.

model.output: Continuous centre, positive dimensions and axial yaw. Original proposals are priors, with access to all seed features.
model.geometry: After first support read, revised geometry and reciprocal messages condition the next support reads. Both roles update jointly.
model.source_loss: Matched object slot and continuous box supervision, instance-support loss on seeds inside labelled boxes, and synthetic known reference supervision. Same supervision in every arm.

arms.joint: All pathways enabled with continuous output
arms.without_feedback: No cross-role messages/pair scores or box-to-support geometry feedback. Same first-read proposal prior, role text, RGB and three shared updates
arms.without_rgb: Zero only the calibrated RGB descriptor; common scene geometry, visibility, role text and geometry feedback retained
arms.fixed_proposals: Same latent joint decoder and continuous loss as joint, plus identical categorical proposal loss available to all arms; output constrained to the original unmodified A256 centre and dimensions plus historical deterministic PCA yaw. No continuous correction at output. Shared proposal readout for every arm.

target_protocol.population: The 18,620 R165 ordinary Validation direction rows, on the three pinned nonprotected R97 manifests.
target_protocol.baseline: R158 + PCA, exact same-row R165 archived boxes
target_protocol.primary_aggregation: Equal weights for six transfer directions, with strict IoU > threshold
target_protocol.secondary: Per-direction and pooled metrics, paired gains/losses, full relation subset, source-held synthetic subject/reference/dual identity and point support. Existing human verified target identities are descriptive when safely joinable.

decision: Report all arms and signs regardless of outcome. Positive attribution to feedback requires the full arm to improve over the matched no-feedback arm; state the limits of any differences, particularly on relationship text. Report the best existing R158 baseline separately and do not promote a weaker system.
